goal: Create an evidence matrix that separates IMS policy, entitlement, registration, capability, call/SMS direction and actual bearer for VoLTE, VoNR, Wi-Fi Calling and SMS over IMS.
official_basis: AOSP IMS service entitlement / GSMA TS.43 integration
Apple Wi-Fi Calling and carrier feature support guidance
key_rules: Carrier policy does not prove IMS registration.
Entitlement/provisioning does not prove IMS registration.
IMS registration does not prove call or SMS success.
Generic voice/SMS success never expands to direction or bearer.
Wi-Fi Calling support does not prove WFC registration or an actual Wi-Fi call.
Apple internal IMS state remains unknown unless directly evidenced.
next_phase: Phase158 LTE/NR registration and APN/DNN/PDU session model.
